steps.description: Inspect the current repository (or create a new one) to confirm no existing Next.js app and verify the presence of a package.json file.
Initialize a fresh Next.js 14+ project with the App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS using `npx create-next-app@latest --ts --app`. Verify that the project builds and runs with `npm run dev`.

Install all required dependencies: `shadcn/ui` primitives, `lucide-react`, `react-markdown`, `remark-gfm`, `prism-react-renderer`, and `next-themes`. Verify that these packages appear in `package.json` and that `npm install` completes without errors.

Configure Tailwind for dark mode, add the custom radial gradient background, and create a `cn` utility (using `class-variance-authority` and `tailwind-merge`). Verify the Tailwind config compiles and the gradient utility class works in a test component.

Generate shadcn/ui components (`button`, `scroll-area`, `avatar`, `dropdown-menu`, `tooltip`, `separator`) via the CLI, then import them into a new `components/` directory. Verify that the generated component files exist and compile without type errors.

Build the main UI components: `ChatLayout` (full‑height container), `Header`, `ChatSidebar`, `EmptyState`, `MessageList`, and `PromptInput`. Mark interactive files with `"use client"` and ensure each compiles. Verify by rendering the `ChatLayout` page and checking that the layout appears without runtime errors.

Implement message state management using React hooks, simulate streaming responses with `setInterval` (or `setTimeout`), and render assistant messages with `react-markdown` + `remark-gfm` + `prism-react-renderer`. Add copy buttons and typing indicator. Verify by typing a user message and confirming progressive text display and markdown rendering.
Add theme toggling via `next-themes` (light/dark) and ensure the UI switches colors correctly. Verify by toggling the theme control and observing background and text color changes.

Persist chat history in `localStorage`: save each conversation, load it on sidebar selection, and provide a “New Chat” button. Verify by creating multiple chats, refreshing the page, and confirming that history reloads correctly.

Run the development server, open the app in a headless browser, capture a screenshot of the empty state, send a test message, capture a screenshot of the active chat with streaming/markdown, and confirm all interactive elements (sidebar, theme toggle, file upload, model selector) function. Verify that no console errors appear during this flow.

Build the production bundle with `npm run build` and start it using `npm start`. Verify that the app launches without errors and that the previously captured screenshots still represent the correct UI in the production build.
